neighbourhoods.title: Neighbourhoods
neighbourhoods.description: StreetEasy-style neighbourhood slugs, e.g. williamsburg, bushwick, bedford-stuyvesant, long-island-city. Mapped to Nooklyn's neighborhood ids. Borough slugs (brooklyn, queens, manhattan, bronx) select the whole borough. Empty = all of Nooklyn's rentals.

maxPrice.title: Max price
maxPrice.description: Maximum monthly rent in USD. Nooklyn matches on gross or net-effective rent, so a listing whose gross rent is above this but net-effective is below can appear.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum rows to push in total, newest first.

fetchDetails.title: Fetch photos and posted date
fetchDetails.description: Per listing, call Nooklyn's images and price-history endpoints to fill up to 8 photos and listedAt (the date of the first price-history entry). Two small JSON requests per listing.

proxyGroups.title: Proxy groups
proxyGroups.description: Apify proxy groups. Empty = datacenter (cheap). Use RESIDENTIAL only if Nooklyn starts blocking datacenter IPs.
